name: The Forgotten Heirloom
objectiveText: Farmer Furlbrow wants you to retrieve his pocket watch from the wardrobe in his farmhouse at the pumpkin farm to the West. Furlbrow's Pocket Watch  ( 1 )

comments.body: Hey thanks for the awesomely useless picture
the correct location of the watch is 49,19

Coordinate: 49,19

The pocket watch is inside a cupboard that you can interact with. The cupboard itself is inside a small house that has 2 guards. One is a level 12 and another is a level 15 named. They are connected to each other, meaning that if you pull either of them, you will pull both. 

Be extra careful especially if you are below level 15. My advice would be to kill the lower level first and then run away and heal up. And then come again to kill the other one.

You can find the watch at:
49,19
[If you run on the road south away from the man you took the quest from, keep right.  It's the first farm to your right named Furlbrow's Pumpkin Patch.  You'll see a barn to the left and a house on the right, in front of all that is a large field.  The watch is inside the house, inside a dresser.]

There are two guards inside the building--level 12ish humanoids.

Rewards: 
10x Freshly Baked Bread
10x Ice Cold Milk

Turn in (or take) the quest at:
60,19
[Without coords: Running from Elwynn Forest into Westfall, the guy greets you just after the bridge when you first enter Westfall.]

this quest is fairly easy, you can complete it without even killing anything, just go to the outside of the house and find where the pointer turns to gear. you should be able to pick the watch from the outside.(its the right wall as you face the door)
replies: Above comment confirmed. If you're outside the house and facing the doorway, go around to the left side of it and get close to the wall. You won't be able to click on the wardrobe through the side wall, but if you position the camera correctly, you can click on it through the front wall, the one with the door on it.  I'll submit a screenshot of this to make it easier to understand.
Thanks for the screen - really helped.

comments.body: The click outside no longer seems to work in WOW classic. The place is covered with lightning fast spawning MOBs. The trappers will trap you, while others run off and attract more. They can even go out and get harvest watchers to add to the fun. Easy quest at level 30. The Fullbrows get murdered by Vanessa VanCleef soon, what do they need a stupid pocket watch for?

Level 13 Paladin, here.

I started by clearing the immediate area around the house. Then I pulled the two mobs from inside the building. I started by stunning Benny Blaanco, so that got me a bit of a head start on the Trapper mob that was accompanying him. Downed her first. I had to bubble up and heal, because ol' Benny had recovered from the stun and obviously wasn't having any of it. Unfortunately I didn't have any potions on me, so by the time my HP was sufficiently up, I was low on mana. Didn’t have the juice to finish him, so I died in agony. Ran back to my corpse as quickly as my spirit legs would carry me. Got my health up and managed to kill Benny without the other mob respawning. I was then able to loot the item from the wardrobe.

Not great, not terrible. 2/5

replies:
49, 20 is a good place to stand.

Essentially stand on the side of the house that has the dresser.  If you're looking at the door, it's on the left side.  Position yourself against the side of the house so that you can whip the camera around and look into the house.  The gear will turn gold when you hover over the dresser.  Click and be happy.  =)

I was 13 when I did this and actually did have to fight 1 mob.  A wandering trapper decided to pick a fight with me.  But at least you won't have to fight the ones inside.  

Have fun!

comments.body: If you look at the map it's the house north of the field directly east of the Jangolode mine (or the second one from the right of the map). There's a level 15 mob and another mob in the house which will probably kill you. If you stand outside of the house you can loot the wardrobe without being attacked.
I am a lvl 13 gnome mage, and tried this twice. The enemy is Benny Blaanco a lvl 15 elite Defias. So if you plan on attempting this mission and are below said lvl, get some help.
Remember to go to the farm house to the west, not to be confused with the house closest to the farmer.

A nice quest with 3 or 4 peeps who are 11 or 12ish.   We, Pally, Priest, and Warlock, pulled everything from the front and west side of house, and the Golems near the house, just to avoid adds. I think you get 3 from the house itself.   If you can, keep fearing Benny until his buddies are  dead, then deal with him.  He is not too tough.  Once clear, everyone just open the wardrobe and grab the bit.
Solo'ed at lvl 15 rogue

I soloed at 14.  There are two mobs in the house.  Pick the one in line of sight and fear.  While he is running send your minion after mob #2.  Since the mobs are now occupied go to the wardrobe and get the watch - then run :)
Solo this at 16 mage

At 49,19 - get the stuff from outside the house to avoid the hassle
